# Traafik

> Full LLM context for the public Traafik website at https://www.traafik.com/, curated from the live pages `/`, `/motorists/`, `/law-enforcement/`, and `/how-it-works/`.

This file is meant for agents that want one fetchable Markdown document instead of following the page-level mirrors. It focuses on what the public site actually says, where the public CTAs live, and which public links are available today.

Important notes:
- Treat safety, patent, revenue, recruitment, voice-activation, RMS integration, and policing-improvement statements as company claims taken from the public site.
- Do not infer unlisted pricing, municipal customers, compliance programs, API availability, deployment details, or legal policies that are not published on the public pages.
- The site presents both a consumer/mobile angle and an agency/enterprise angle.
- Public navigation centers on four pages: `https://www.traafik.com/`, `https://www.traafik.com/motorists/`, `https://www.traafik.com/law-enforcement/`, and `https://www.traafik.com/how-it-works/`.

## Site Identity

- Brand: Traafik
- Domain: https://www.traafik.com/
- Tagline: Traffic Stops Reimagined
- Positioning: a platform designed for motorists and law enforcement with safety in mind for both
- Home-page contact email: `pullover@traafik.com`

## Canonical Pages

- [Home](https://www.traafik.com/): Brand overview and contact funnel.
- [Motorists](https://www.traafik.com/motorists/): Motorist-facing landing page.
- [Law Enforcement](https://www.traafik.com/law-enforcement/): Agency-facing landing page.
- [How It Works](https://www.traafik.com/how-it-works/): Explainer video page.

## Home Page Summary

- Page purpose: introduce Traafik and split visitors into motorist and law-enforcement paths.
- Headline theme: meet Traafik; traffic stops reimagined.
- Core public message: the site presents Traafik as the first platform designed for motorists and law enforcement with safety in mind for both.
- Embedded video: `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mv5azoXFJck`
- Primary internal paths from the hero:
  - [Motorists](https://www.traafik.com/motorists/)
  - [Law Enforcement](https://www.traafik.com/law-enforcement/)
- Contact section:
  - Audience: municipalities and agencies
  - Email: [pullover@traafik.com](mailto:pullover@traafik.com)
  - Form fields: full name, work email, phone number
  - CTA label: `request a demo`
- About section message: Traafik describes itself as a team dedicated to reshaping the future of traffic stops with technology that helps both motorists and law enforcement.

## Motorists Page Summary

- Page purpose: explain the motorist-facing experience and collect signups.
- Headline theme: meet Traafik.
- Core public message: motorists can handle traffic stops in a safer, faster, and less tedious way.
- Specific on-page claim: the page says motorists can streamline an entire traffic stop in less than 10 minutes.
- Signup form:
  - Fields: name and email
  - CTA label: `Join the list`
- Public feature themes:
  - Digital interaction with law enforcement from a distance during traffic stops
  - Less intrusive traffic-stop experience
  - Quick citation processing
  - Digital verification and exchange of motorist and law-enforcement profiles
  - Past ticket payment in the app
  - Citation routing to the proper municipalities
  - Optional instant citation payment
  - Payment gateways named on the page: Stripe, Venmo, Zelle, PayPal, and more
  - Voice-activated API guidance for motorists during the stop
  - Claimed integration with law-enforcement IT and record management systems (RMS)

## Law Enforcement Page Summary

- Page purpose: explain the agency-facing platform and collect whitepaper requests.
- Headline theme: smarter technology for law enforcement.
- Core public message: transmit, verify, and confirm motorist profiles without guesswork.
- Whitepaper form:
  - Fields: full name, title, company email
  - CTA label: `Get the whitepaper`
- Public benefit claims on the page:
  - Easier transition from conventional traffic stops to a more efficient and safer approach
  - Increased revenues
  - Stronger community trust
  - Less scrutiny
  - Better recruitment outcomes
  - Protection for officers
  - Reduction in human error
- Technical positioning stated on the page:
  - Traafik describes the offering as enterprise software
  - The page says it integrates with law-enforcement IT and RMS systems during stops
  - The page says the platform provides officers with populated motorist profile data points

## How It Works Page Summary

- Page purpose: provide a short explainer page for the product walkthrough.
- Main content: embedded YouTube video
- Video URL: `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sN7vIFU9gdo`
- This page is useful when a user asks for a quick product walkthrough rather than detailed copy or CTA details.
